title: Russia Launches a Nuclear Strike on America... What Happens Next?
description:
It is 3:40 in the morning in Nebraska. Within 90 seconds, more than 300 Russian missiles are in the air. This is a minute-by-minute simulation of a Russian first strike on the United States, built from real force data, real bases and published blast models: from the first silo opening to the warhead that lands on Offutt Air Force Base at minute 27, and the world that comes after.

This is a simulation. It has not happened. Scenario segments are labelled SIMULATION on screen; facts are labelled REAL DATA or REAL HISTORY.

Chapters
0:00 Cold open
0:42 The real forces
2:43 Thirty minutes
3:45 The warning shot that was never answered
4:45 Minute by minute
7:42 One warhead
8:55 The day after
10:11 How close it has come
11:13 The clock

Key sources
- SIPRI Yearbook 2026, World Nuclear Forces: https://www.sipri.org/sites/default/files/YB26%2008%20World%20Nuclear%20Forces.pdf
- Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists, Russian nuclear weapons 2025: https://thebulletin.org/premium/2025-05/russian-nuclear-weapons-2025/
- Global Zero, launch-on-warning timeline (Bruce Blair): https://www.globalzero.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Full-LOWTimeline.pdf
- Princeton Science and Global Security, Plan A: https://sgs.princeton.edu/the-lab/plan-a
- Xia et al., Nature Food (2022): https://www.nature.com/articles/s43016-022-00573-0
- National Security Archive, false warnings of 1979 and 1980: https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/node/2738
Blast, thermal and fallout figures: Glasstone and Dolan, The Effects of Nuclear Weapons (1977), calibrated to NUKEMAP by Alex Wellerstein. Fallout guidance: Ready.gov.

How this video was made: the narration is AI-generated (Google Text-to-Speech). Scenario segments are simulations built from published models and open sources; the target list and timings are ours, a scenario, not a forecast.
Maps: Natural Earth (public domain), OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles. Imagery: NASA Blue Marble and Black Marble. Music: generated with Eleven Music.
